in_hebrew.name: פוביאן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'pav', which means 'grace' or 'favor', and the suffix 'ian', which means 'one who is' or 'belonging to'. Thus, the name Favian means 'one who is gracious or kind'.

in_greek.name: Φοβιαν
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'phobos', which means 'fear' or 'reverence', and the suffix 'ian', which means 'one who is' or 'belonging to'. Thus, the name Favian could also mean 'one who is fearful or reverent'.

in_latin.name: Favianus
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'favus', which means 'favorable' or 'kind', and the suffix '-ianus', which means 'one who is' or 'belonging to'. Thus, the name Favian means 'one who is favorable or kind'.
